targets.recommended_evidence_quality_note: V3-EXQ-914a's null C_MAIN result (mean gap 0.0032, 1/5 seeds passing) is a test-design artifact, not evidence against MECH-236. Code trace of _score_trajectory (ree_core/hippocampal/module.py:1513) confirms the CEM elite-selection scoring function has no functional connection to resource-benefit/goal-relatedness under this run's configuration: wanting_weight=0.0 (the only goal-weighted scoring term, deliberately zeroed to isolate the channel), benefit_terrain_enabled=False (default, unset), and NUM_HAZARDS=0 (so the remaining ARC-007 residue-field term, a harm-accumulation mechanism, has nothing to accumulate). The ghost-probe channel itself functions correctly (P1/P2 preconditions both met) -- it proposes goal-tagged candidates, but nothing downstream can preferentially select them. See failure_autopsy_V3-EXQ-914-914a_2026-08-13 for the full trace. Recommend non_contributory/standard, pending a redesign (V3-EXQ-914b) that gives CEM elite-selection a real reward-linked term reachable jointly with the ghost-probe channel.
learning_extracted: HippocampalModule._score_trajectory (CEM elite-selection scoring) is goal-blind by default: wanting_weight=0 and benefit_terrain_enabled=False are both REEConfig defaults, and the remaining ARC-007 residue-field term is a harm-accumulation mechanism with nothing to accumulate when NUM_HAZARDS=0. Any future MECH-236/MECH-292/MECH-293 evidence run must deliberately enable a reward-linked scoring term or the result cannot discriminate the channel's effect from scoring-blindness.

The substrate_queue.json modulatory-bias-selection-authority fix (E3.select, implemented) does not reach into the hippocampal CEM's own internal elite-selection/refit step -- a goal-blind refit can discard a genuinely better candidate before E3 ever sees it. Not routed as new substrate work here since the existing lever (wanting_weight) already covers it; flagged for a future session if this call site recurs as a blocker across more than this one claim.

P1 precondition threshold (>= 0.0, direction lower) passes even a fully-inert cell (seed 46: 0 ghost candidates admitted the entire run), which is then still counted in the 5-seed C_MAIN denominator as if informative. Worth tightening in any successor driver reusing this precondition pattern.

NUM_HAZARDS=0 (a reasonable choice to avoid a documented untrained-agent death confound) silences ARC-007's residue field entirely when it is the sole scoring term -- a general caution for any future driver relying on ARC-007 STRICT terrain scoring as its only candidate differentiator in a zero-hazard environment.
